items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And I played cornet at the 91 Theater, with Eddie Heywood Hayward's father.

ctx.x: No, before that. I would go to Atlanta, during the school's -- summertime, I'd go to Atlanta because I had an aunt there that was married to a Chinaman, and he had a laundry there so I used to go down in the summer and work in the laundry. And I played cornet at the 91 Theater, with Eddie Heywood Hayward's father.
